# Job Chapter 38 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 430v–431r

---

**38:1** And-answered [vaya'an] YHWH [את] Iyyov from-the-whirlwind [min-ha-se'arah] and-said: **38:2** "Who [is] this who-darkens [machshikh] counsel [etsah] with-words [be-millin] without knowledge [beli-da'at]?

**38:3** Gird [ezar] now your-loins [chalatsekha] like-a-man [ke-gaver]; and-I-will-ask-you [ve-eshalkha] and-make-known [hodi'eni] to-me.

**38:4** Where were-you [eifoh hayita] when-I-laid-the-foundation [be-yasdi] of-the-earth [erets]? Tell [hagged], if you-know [yada'ta] understanding [vinah]. **38:5** Who set [sam] its-measurements [memaddeha] — if [ki] you-know [teda]? Or-who stretched [natah] upon-it a-measuring-line [qav]? **38:6** Upon what [al-mah] were-its-bases [adaneha] sunk [hotba'u]? Or-who laid [yarah] its-cornerstone [even pinnatah], **38:7** when-sang-together [be-ron-yachad] the-stars of-morning [kokhvei voqer], and-shouted-for-joy [vayari'u] all the-sons of-God [kol-benei elohim]?

**38:8** And-who-shut-in [vayasekh] the-sea [yam] with-doors [bi-delatayim], when-it-burst-forth [be-gicho] from-the-womb [me-rechem] it-came-out [yetse]? **38:9** When-I-made [be-sumi] cloud [anan] its-garment [levusho], and-thick-darkness [va-arafel] its-swaddling-band [chatullato]. **38:10** And-I-broke [va-eshbor] upon-it my-decree [chuqqi], and-I-set [va-asim] bars [beri'ach] and-doors [u-delatayim]. **38:11** And-I-said, 'To-here [ad-poh] you-shall-come [tavo] and-not further [ve-lo tosif], and-here [u-pho] shall-be-set [yashit] the-pride [be-ga'on] of-your-waves [galleikha].'

**38:12** Have-you ever in-your-days [mi-yamekha] commanded [tsivvita] the-morning [boqer]? [Or] made-known [yidda'ta] to-the-dawn [shachar] its-place [meqomo]? **38:13** To-grasp [le-echoz] the-wings [be-kanfot] of-the-earth [ha-arets], and-the-wicked [resha'im] are-shaken [veyyina'aru] from-it? **38:14** It-transforms-itself [tithappekh] like-clay [ke-chomer] of-a-seal [chotam], and-they-stand-forth [veyityatssevu] like-a-garment [kemo levush]. **38:15** And-is-withheld [veyimmane'a] from-the-wicked [me-resha'im] their-light [oram], and-the-arm [u-zero'a] raised-high [ramah] is-broken [tishaver].

**38:16** Have-you-entered [havo'ta] to the-springs of-the-sea [nivekhei-yam]? And-in-the-recesses of-the-deep [be-cheqer tehom] have-you-walked [hithhallakhta]? **38:17** Have-the-gates of-death [sha'arei-mavet] been-revealed [nigle'u] to-you? And-the-gates of-deep-darkness [sha'arei tsalmavet] do-you-see [tir'eh]?

**38:18** Have-you-comprehended [hitbonanta] the-expanses of-the-earth [rachavei-arets]? Tell [hagged], if you-know [yada'ta] all of-it [kullahh].

**38:19** Where [is] the-way [ha-derekh] [to where] light [or] dwells [yishkon]? And-darkness [choshekh] — where [is] its-place [meqomo]? **38:20** That you-should-take-it [tiqqachenu] to its-territory [el-gevulo], and-that you-should-perceive [thavin] the-paths [netivot] to-its-house [beito]?

**38:21** You-know [yada'ta], for then [az] you-were-born [tivvaled], and-the-number of-your-days [yamekha] [is] great [rabbim]!

**38:22** Have-you-entered [havo'ta] the-storehouses of-the-snow [otsrot sheleg]? And-the-storehouses of-the-hail [otsrot barad] do-you-see [tir'eh]? **38:23** Which I-have-reserved [chasakhti] for-a-time of-distress [le-et-tsar], for-a-day of-battle [le-yom qerav] and-war [u-milchamah]?

**38:24** By-what way [derekh] is-the-light [or] distributed [yechalleq], [and] the-east-wind [qadim] scattered [yafets] upon the-earth [alei-arets]? **38:25** Who has-cleft [pillag] a-channel [te'alah] for-the-flood [la-shetef], and-a-way [derekh] for-the-thunderbolt [la-chaziz qolot]? **38:26** To-bring-rain [le-hamtir] on-a-land [al-erets] [where there is] no-man [lo-ish], a-wilderness [midbar] [with] no human [lo-adam] in-it? **38:27** To-satisfy [le-hasbi'a] desolation [sho'ah] and-waste [u-mesho'ah], and-to-cause-to-sprout [u-le-hatsmia'ach] the-going-forth of-grass [motsa deshe]?

**38:28** Does-the-rain [matar] have a-father [av]? Or-who begot [holid] the-drops of-dew [eglei-tal]? **38:29** From-whose-womb [mi-beten mi] came-forth [yatsa] the-ice [ha-qerach]? And-the-frost of-heaven [kfor shamayim], who bore-it [yeladdo]? **38:30** Like-stone [ka-even] the-waters [mayim] hide-themselves [yitchaba'u], and-the-face of-the-deep [penei tehom] is-frozen [yitlakkedu].

**38:31** Can-you-bind [ha-teqasher] the-chains [ma'adannot] of-the-Pleiades [Kimah]? Or-the-cords [moshkhot] of-Orion [Kesil], can-you-loose [tefatte'ach]? **38:32** Can-you-bring-forth [ha-totsi] the-Mazzaroth [mazzarot] in-its-season [be-itto]? And-the-Bear [Ayish] with-its-sons [al-baneha], can-you-guide-them [tanchem]?

**38:33** Do-you-know [hayada'ta] the-statutes of-the-heavens [chuqqot shamayim]? Or-can-you-establish [tasim] their-rule [mishtaro] on-the-earth [ba-arets]?

**38:34** Can-you-lift-up [hatarim] your-voice [qolekha] to-the-clouds [la-av], and-an-abundance [shif'at] of-water [mayim] covers-you [tekhasseka]? **38:35** Can-you-send-out [ha-teshalach] lightnings [beraqim] and-they-go [veyelekhu]? And-will-they-say [vayomeru] to-you, 'Here-we-are [hinnenu]'?

**38:36** Who placed [shat] wisdom [chokhmah] in-the-inward-parts [ba-tuchot]? Or-who gave [natan] understanding [vinah] to-the-mind [la-sekhvi]? **38:37** Who can-number [yesapper] the-clouds [shechakim] in-wisdom [be-chokhmah]? And-the-jars of-heaven [niblei shamayim], who can-tilt-them [yashkiv]?

**38:38** When-the-dust [be-tsheqet afar] is-poured into-a-mass [la-mutsaq], and-the-clods [u-regevim] cling-together [yedubbaqe]?

**38:39** Can-you-hunt [ha-tatsud] prey [teref] for-the-lion [la-lavi]? And-the-appetite [chayyat] of-the-young-lions [kefirim] can-you-fill [temalle]? **38:40** When they-crouch [yashochu] in-the-dens [ba-me'onot], they-sit [yeshvu] in-the-thicket [ba-sukkah] in-ambush [le-mo-arev]? **38:41** Who provides [yakhin] for-the-raven [la-orev] its-prey [tseido], when its-young [yeladav] cry [yeshavve'u] to God [el-El] [and] wander [yita'u] for-lack of-food [li-vli-okhel]?"

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "from the whirlwind":** Hebrew *min-ha-se'arah* — the storm (*se'arah*) that Elihu has been describing now becomes the vehicle of theophany. God does not come after the storm but in it. This is the most dramatic moment in the book.

**v.7 — "when the morning stars sang together":** Hebrew *be-ron-yachad kokhvei voqer* — the creation is depicted as a cosmic celebration. The stars sing; the *benei elohim* (sons of God/divine beings) shout for joy. Creation is not mere fabrication but an event of beauty and delight.

**v.31-32 — Pleiades, Orion, Mazzaroth, the Bear:** These are the only star-names in Job. *Kimah* = Pleiades (the cluster); *Kesil* = Orion (the fool); *Mazzarot* = possibly the zodiacal constellations or planets; *Ayish* = the Great Bear (Ursa Major). God's sovereignty extends to the constellations themselves.

**v.36 — "inward parts" and "mind":** Hebrew *tuchot* and *sekhvi* are disputed. They may refer to the ibis and the rooster (animals associated with weather-wisdom in Egyptian thought), or to the human mind and heart. The ambiguity may be intentional.

*— EMET*
